2026-09-17.title: 路透：AI 竞争阴影笼罩特朗普与习近平峰会
2026-09-17.title_en: AI rivalry hangs over Trump-Xi talks
2026-09-17.title_zh: 路透：AI 竞争阴影笼罩特朗普与习近平峰会
2026-09-17.summary: 路透社发布解读稿指出，人工智能主导权之争将成为下周特朗普与习近平华盛顿会晤的核心背景议题。双方都把 AI 进展视为经济与军事竞争力的关键，但在先进芯片获取、技术抄袭指控与 AI 行业监管三个方向持续对立。美国财政部长贝森特表示将于本周末会见中国副总理何立峰，先行讨论 AI 相关问题。报道梳理了五大分歧点：①军事风险——美中安全专家呼吁就核指挥系统红线、重大网络攻击的人类控制权以及自主 AI 事件热线建立机制，避免事故被误判为攻击；②技术抄袭——「蒸馏」（用大模型输出训练小模型）成为焦点，美方 9 月指控六家中国企业以「工业化规模」恶意复制美国 AI 产品，并称其行为「很可能在中国政府知情下进行」，中方驻美使馆称指控「毫无根据」；③芯片出口——自 2022 年以来美方对华实施全面管制，正考虑限制中国企业远程访问境外数据中心的算力，但去年底特朗普批准了英伟达 H200 芯片对华销售；④监管取向——特朗普拒绝新的联邦 AI 规则，称美国只需要强有力的总统，并把 AI 高管呼吁监管称为「骗局」，而中国对算法与训练数据设有规则并要求 AI 生成内容明确标识；⑤发展差距——美方评估中国模型落后数月，业界则认为已接近并驾齐驱。

2026-09-17.summary: 路透社报道，美国众议院通过一项制裁与关税法案，以加大对俄罗斯的经济压力。该法案授权总统对购买俄罗斯能源的主要买家加征关税，并授权对协助俄方规避制裁的实体实施惩罚性措施。法案以 262 票对 159 票通过，是国会两年多来首次通过支持乌克兰的立法。由于中国和印度是俄罗斯能源的主要买家，法案的实际适用范围可能波及中印企业，法案下一步将送交特朗普签署。

2026-09-17.title: FT：中美 AI 监管分歧难弥合 双方对「何种 AI 风险优先」认知迥异
2026-09-17.title_en: US-China AI regulation remains difficult despite shared concerns
2026-09-17.title_zh: FT：中美 AI 监管分歧难弥合 双方对「何种 AI 风险优先」认知迥异
2026-09-17.summary: 英国《金融时报》9月16日刊文指出，美国与中国在人工智能治理上虽然都对日益强大的 AI 系统所带来风险存有共同关切，但技术竞争使双方合作变得极为困难。文章认为，两国对「何种 AI 风险应当优先」的判断存在根本分歧：美方关注的是中国可能获取可支撑先进军事、情报与网络能力的技术，出口管制范围已从半导体硬件扩展至模型权重、技术知识与远程算力访问；中方则更强调国家安全、社会稳定与境外势力对 AI 的运用，将美方管制视为以安全为名迟滞中国创新的战略手段。文章指出，AI 议题在即将举行的特朗普与习近平会晤中料将成为讨论内容之一，但双方在国家安全、技术管制与 AI 发展节奏上的分歧仍是建立双边安全机制的重大障碍。

2026-09-17.title: 中国 AI 股跌势加剧 美国同业推动限制中国获取前沿模型
2026-09-17.title_en: China AI Stocks’ Pain Grows as US Rivals Push for Model Curbs
2026-09-17.title_zh: 中国 AI 股跌势加剧 美国同业推动限制中国获取前沿模型
2026-09-17.summary: 彭博社9月17日报道，中国人工智能开发企业在本轮股市抛售中已损失数十亿美元，而美国同业推动切断中国竞争对手获取前沿模型的举措若成功，可能进一步加剧其困境。报道称，智谱与 MiniMax 股价 9 月以来均下跌逾 30%，合计市值蒸发 330 亿美元，主因竞争激烈与市场对现金消耗的担忧。投资者关注的新风险来自 Anthropic 等美国企业呼吁决策者限制中国获取其模型，并指控部分中国竞争对手未经许可使用美国模型、通过「蒸馏」方式训练自有模型。
2026-09-17.summary_en: China’s AI developers have already lost billions in a bruising stock selloff, and a push by US developers to cut Chinese rivals off from frontier models threatens to add to the pain if it succeeds. Shares of Z.AI Co. and MiniMax Group Inc. have plunged more than 30% each in September, wiping $33 billion from their combined market value amid fierce competition and concerns over cash burn. Now investors see a looming risk as Anthropic PBC and other US developers call on policymakers to restrict Chinese access, accusing some rivals of using American models without approval to train their own through a practice known as distillation.

2026-09-17.summary_en: Taiwan’s coast guard is planning its first visit to the Philippines in decades, strengthening ties as China boosts naval activity in the region. Funding for the visit is included in Taiwan’s 2027 budget, though it’s unclear if more than one vessel would be dispatched. The coast guard hasn’t visited the Philippines publicly since 1974, according to the Taipei-based Liberty Times, which earlier reported the proposal.

2026-09-17.summary_en: Chinese-founded AI startup Manus is set to double its valuation to $4 billion in its first fundraising since Beijing ordered it to split from Meta Platforms Inc. The planned $500 million financing round is set to close soon and would make the agentic AI pioneer China’s most valuable startup in its field, according to people familiar with the matter. Manus’ existing backers include Tencent Holdings Ltd., HSG and ZhenFund.

2026-09-17.title: 美等11国发表联合声明 指朝鲜海外劳工多集中于中国和俄罗斯

2026-09-17.title_zh: 美等11国发表联合声明 指朝鲜海外劳工多集中于中国和俄罗斯
2026-09-17.summary: The Multilateral Sanctions Monitoring Team, comprising 11 governments including the United States, Japan and South Korea, released a report on the DPRK's overseas labour program, estimating 35,600 to 101,280 North Korean labourers deployed abroad — nearly all in China and Russia — generating $450-800 million in 2025 to fund Pyongyang's nuclear and missile programs.
2026-09-17.summary_en: The Multilateral Sanctions Monitoring Team, comprising 11 governments including the United States, Japan and South Korea, released a report on the DPRK's overseas labour program, estimating 35,600 to 101,280 North Korean labourers deployed abroad — nearly all in China and Russia — generating $450-800 million in 2025 to fund Pyongyang's nuclear and missile programs.
2026-09-17.summary_zh: 美国、澳大利亚、加拿大、法国、德国、意大利、日本、荷兰、新西兰、韩国、英国等11国组成的多边制裁监督小组（MSMT）9月16日发布关于朝鲜海外劳工项目的报告。报告估算朝鲜仍在海外部署约3.56万至10.128万名劳工，其中绝大多数位于中国和俄罗斯；2025年这些劳工为朝鲜带来4.5亿至8亿美元收入，用于资助其核武器与弹道导弹项目。报告称约2万至7万名朝鲜劳工在中国，2025年1月至2026年1月期间又有约1万名新劳工抵华；在俄劳工至2025年底达1.5万至3万人，并在俄境内无人机工厂为俄制造军用无人机。声明呼吁联合国安理会按2024年4月解散前的规模和架构重建专家小组。

2026-09-17.summary_en: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority followed the US Federal Reserve in raising interest rates for the first time since 2023, a decision that could threaten a property recovery unfolding since last year. The HKMA lifted its benchmark by 25 basis points to 4.25%, according to a statement on Thursday. The de facto central bank in the city moves in lockstep with the Fed to protect the local dollar’s peg to the greenback.

2026-09-17.summary: Politico 报道，围绕人工智能风险曾短暂形成的跨党派与业界共识已经瓦解。随着 AI 安全议题政治化，各方在如何应对前沿模型威胁上出现明显分裂：一部分人主张设定强制安全标准与放缓节奏，另一部分人则认为监管会削弱美国相对中国的竞争优势。报道指出，这一分裂使国会短期内通过实质性 AI 立法的可能性下降，政策走向更多取决于白宫与行业游说的博弈。

2026-09-17.title_en: Restoring Reciprocity in Government Procurement
2026-09-17.title_zh: 白宫发布政府采购互惠备忘录 要求清除联邦采购中的加拿大原产商品
2026-09-17.summary: President Trump issued a presidential memorandum directing OMB, USTR and the Federal Acquisition Regulatory Council to identify and remove Canadian origin items from the Federal civil procurement system, in response to Canada's "Buy Canadian" policy and provincial procurement barriers against U.S. companies.
2026-09-17.summary_en: President Trump issued a presidential memorandum directing OMB, USTR and the Federal Acquisition Regulatory Council to identify and remove Canadian origin items from the Federal civil procurement system, in response to Canada's "Buy Canadian" policy and provincial procurement barriers against U.S. companies.
2026-09-17.summary_zh: 特朗普9月16日签署总统备忘录，指示白宫管理与预算办公室、美国贸易代表办公室及联邦采购监管委员会，识别并采取措施将加拿大原产商品从联邦民用采购体系中移除或使其不可采购，以回应加拿大「购买加拿大货」政策及各省对美国企业的采购壁垒。备忘录称加拿大企业目前仍可优惠进入美国政府采购市场，其中包括世贸组织《政府采购协定》覆盖的每年逾2800亿美元联邦采购；美方同时要求贸易代表持续监控加方联邦及省级采购市场对美国原产商品的待遇，并在条件变化时评估恢复加方商品准入。

2026-09-17.title_zh: 美国宣布制裁巴勒斯坦权力机构及巴解组织官员
2026-09-17.summary: The State Department reported to Congress that the PLO and Palestinian Authority have again failed to meet their commitments under PLOCCA and MEPCA, and will extend visa-denial sanctions against PLO members and PA officials under section 604(a)(1) of the MEPCA.
2026-09-17.summary_en: The State Department reported to Congress that the PLO and Palestinian Authority have again failed to meet their commitments under PLOCCA and MEPCA, and will extend visa-denial sanctions against PLO members and PA officials under section 604(a)(1) of the MEPCA.
2026-09-17.summary_zh: 美国国务院9月16日向国会报告称，巴勒斯坦解放组织和巴勒斯坦权力机构再次未能履行其在《1989年巴解组织承诺遵守法》和《2002年中东和平承诺法》下的承诺，包括在国际组织中推动削弱安理会第242、338号决议的行动、通过国际刑事法院和国际法院将巴以冲突国际化、寻求绕过谈判获得单边承认，以及继续向恐怖分子发放津贴并在公开声明和教科书中美化恐怖主义。据此美方将依据《中东和平承诺法》第604(a)(1)条延长对巴解组织成员和巴权力机构官员的签证限制制裁。

2026-09-18.summary_zh: 彭博社援引知情人士报道，美国预计将把针对贸易伙伴「产能过剩」指控的新关税公告至少推迟到下周习近平与特朗普的峰会之后。彭博社此前报道称，美方原计划在美中元首会晤前发布一份关于产能过剩的贸易报告，其中建议对中国商品加征 7.5% 的关税。报道称推迟的原因尚不清楚。此举被视为美方在峰会前避免制造新的摩擦点、为达成经贸成果预留空间的信号。

2026-09-18.title_en: China's US Treasury holdings fall to lowest level since 2008

2026-09-18.summary_zh: 《金融时报》报道，美国财政部国际资本流动（TIC）数据显示，中国 7 月持有的美国国债降至 6180 亿美元，较 6 月的 6334 亿美元减少 154 亿美元，为 2008 年 8 月以来最低水平。中国在美国国债海外持有者中的排名滑落至第三位，仅次于日本与英国，持仓不足 2013 年 11 月逾 1.3 万亿美元峰值的一半。同期海外投资者持有美债总量降至 9.25 万亿美元，连续第二个月下滑。分析认为，这并非短期恐慌性抛售，而是长期储备战略调整，中国黄金储备已连续 22 个月增持。

2026-09-19.summary: On Friday, September 18, 2026, the President signed into law: H.R. 5334, the “Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026,” which authorizes and expands statutory sanctions, tariffs, and prohibitions on Russia and extends existing sanctions on Iran.

2026-09-19.summary_zh: 白宫 9 月 18 日宣布，特朗普总统当日签署 H.R. 5334 号法案，即《2026 年林赛·O·格雷厄姆制裁俄罗斯与伊朗法案》。该法案授权并扩大对俄罗斯的法定制裁、关税与禁止性措施，同时延长对伊朗的现行制裁。此举标志着国会此前通过的对俄制裁立法正式生效；法案中的关税授权条款此前已引发外界关注，因其可能波及继续购买俄罗斯能源的中国、印度等买家。

2026-09-19.title_en: Enhancing Program Integrity and Interagency Coordination in the Administration of the H-1B Nonimmigrant Visa Program
2026-09-19.title_zh: 特朗普签署行政令 收紧 H-1B 签证以保护美国本土劳工
2026-09-19.summary: ENHANCING PROGRAM INTEGRITY AND INTERAGENCY COORDINATION IN THE ADMINISTRATION OF THE H-1B NONIMMIGRANT VISA PROGRAM, September 18, 2026. By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution and the laws of the United States of America, it is hereby ordered: Section 1. Purpose. The H-1B nonimmigrant visa program was created to identify uniquely skilled and highly specialized foreign temporary workers to strategically supplement the United States economy. Instead, the program has been widely abused by certain employers, third-party placement groups, and outsourcing firms to undercut and displace the supply of skilled United States labor.
2026-09-19.summary_en: ENHANCING PROGRAM INTEGRITY AND INTERAGENCY COORDINATION IN THE ADMINISTRATION OF THE H-1B NONIMMIGRANT VISA PROGRAM, September 18, 2026. By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution and the laws of the United States of America, it is hereby ordered: Section 1. Purpose. The H-1B nonimmigrant visa program was created to identify uniquely skilled and highly specialized foreign temporary workers to strategically supplement the United States economy. Instead, the program has been widely abused by certain employers, third-party placement groups, and outsourcing firms to undercut and displace the supply of skilled United States labor.
2026-09-19.summary_zh: 白宫 9 月 18 日发布行政令，认定 H-1B 非移民签证项目被部分雇主、第三方派遣与外包公司“大规模系统性滥用”，用以压低薪酬、取代美国本土技术劳工，估计 H-1B 持有者薪酬较同等本土员工低 9,000 至 20,000 美元。行政令要求国务院、劳工部、国土安全部在审理劳工条件申请与签证时，与商务部、教育部及小企业管理局协商核查；并将“雇主在申请前一年内直接或间接裁员”列为审签考量因素。劳工部须在 30 日内启动对已提交申请的复查，判断是否需依《移民与国籍法》第 212(n)(2)(G) 条追责，同时将总统依第 215(a) 条的部分授权下放给上述四部门。此举将直接影响美国科技企业的技术人才引进与外包用工模式。

2026-09-19.summary: Secretary of State Marco Rubio will travel to New York City from September 20–23 to advance an agenda of peace, prosperity, and the primacy of nations during the 81st session of the UN General Assembly. Joining President Trump, Secretary Rubio will advocate for the United Nations to return to its core mandate of maintaining international peace and security while respecting national sovereignty. While in New York, Secretary Rubio will meet with foreign counterparts to discuss shared security and economic priorities, support peace efforts, and strengthen cooperation on priority issues.

Joining President Trump, Secretary Rubio will advocate for the United Nations to return to its core mandate of maintaining international peace and security while respecting national sovereignty. While in New York, Secretary Rubio will meet with foreign counterparts to discuss shared security and economic priorities, support peace efforts, and strengthen cooperation on priority issues.
2026-09-19.summary_zh: 美国国务院 9 月 18 日宣布，国务卿鲁比奥将于 9 月 20 日至 23 日前往纽约出席第 81 届联合国大会高级别周，推进“和平、繁荣与国家本位”议程。鲁比奥将随特朗普总统出席，主张联合国回归维护国际和平与安全、同时尊重国家主权的核心使命。期间他将与多国外长会晤，讨论共同的安全与经济优先事项、支持和平努力并加强重点议题合作；美方并称将在高级别周期间与其他会员国合作，延续过去一年取得的联合国改革成果。

2026-09-23.summary: Today, President Donald J. Trump joined leaders of Denmark and Greenland to sign an unprecedented agreement giving the United States lasting control over Greenland's security interests at no cost to American taxpayers, including permanent basing rights and a provision barring any U.S. adversary from establishing bases, military presence or making sensitive investments without U.S. approval.
2026-09-23.summary_en: Today, President Donald J. Trump joined leaders of Denmark and Greenland to sign an unprecedented agreement giving the United States lasting control over Greenland's security interests at no cost to American taxpayers, including permanent basing rights and a provision barring any U.S. adversary from establishing bases, military presence or making sensitive investments without U.S. approval.
2026-09-23.summary_zh: 2026年9月22日，特朗普总统与丹麦首相弗雷泽里克森、格陵兰总理尼尔森共同签署协定，修订并补充1951年《格陵兰防务协议》，赋予美国对格陵兰安全利益的“永久控制权”与永久基地权，且不给美国纳税人增加成本。协定含排他条款：未经美方批准，任何美国对手不得在格陵兰建立基地、军事存在或进行敏感投资；同时确保格陵兰关键矿产不落入中国或俄罗斯之手。鲁比奥称，格陵兰将永久成为北美战略防御区的一部分，任何对手都将被排除在该地区及其周边之外；参议员麦考密克称该协定对美国“金色穹顶”防御体系具关键作用。特朗普称协定赋予美国对该领土安全及所有其他需求的永久控制权。丹麦外长拉斯穆森强调，协定充分尊重丹麦王国的主权和领土完整以及格陵兰人民的自决权。北约秘书长吕特、欧盟委员会主席冯德莱恩、德国总理默茨、挪威首相斯特勒、意大利总理梅洛尼等多国政要表态支持。

2026-09-23.title_zh: 美国等15国发表《捍卫西半球主权联合声明》 启动“美洲之盾”三支柱
2026-09-23.summary: The text of the following statement was released by the Governments of the United States of America, Argentina, Bolivia, Chile, Colombia, Costa Rica, Dominican Republic, Ecuador, El Salvador, Guyana, Honduras, Panama, Paraguay, Peru, and Trinidad and Tobago. We, the Heads of State and Government participating in the Shield of the Americas, jointly declare our intention to strengthen the resilience of the Western Hemisphere through three pillars: Economic, Security, and Multilateral Coordination, including exploring investment screening mechanisms, safeguarding critical minerals supply chains through diversified and reliable sourcing, and promoting trusted supplier regulations for digital infrastructure.
2026-09-23.summary_en: The text of the following statement was released by the Governments of the United States of America, Argentina, Bolivia, Chile, Colombia, Costa Rica, Dominican Republic, Ecuador, El Salvador, Guyana, Honduras, Panama, Paraguay, Peru, and Trinidad and Tobago. We, the Heads of State and Government participating in the Shield of the Americas, jointly declare our intention to strengthen the resilience of the Western Hemisphere through three pillars: Economic, Security, and Multilateral Coordination, including exploring investment screening mechanisms, safeguarding critical minerals supply chains through diversified and reliable sourcing, and promoting trusted supplier regulations for digital infrastructure.
2026-09-23.summary_zh: 2026年9月22日，美国、阿根廷、玻利维亚、智利、哥伦比亚、哥斯达黎加、多米尼加、厄瓜多尔、萨尔瓦多、圭亚那、洪都拉斯、巴拿马、巴拉圭、秘鲁、特立尼达和多巴哥15国政府发布《捍卫西半球主权联合声明》，宣布启动“美洲之盾”经济、安全与多边协调三大支柱。经济方面提出加强经济合作、探索投资审查机制、通过多元化可靠来源保障关键矿产供应链，并对数字基础设施推行“可信供应商”规则；安全方面协调制裁、认定与金融行动打击武装毒品恐怖网络，扩大民事执法；多边方面在各类多边场合捍卫国家主权与自决。声明同时宣布首个联合行动：对 MS-13、锡那罗亚集团、CJNG、 Tren de Aragua 等24个跨国有组织犯罪集团实施资产冻结、移民与签证限制及刑事责任追究，并拟联署请求美洲国家组织常设理事会召开磋商会议，依《里约条约》设立磋商机构、以部长级参与推动集体行动。
